decision_lens: Does the cost trajectory ($1.17 to $2.93) reflect genuine improvement-via-evidence or improvement-via-spending-more-on-review, and how would the document distinguish those?
focus: Cost dynamics, model routing, and agent-fleet economics under the cost-per-landable-change north star
name: fd-dispatch-economics
persona: Apply the perspective of an MLOps practitioner who has run mixed-model agent fleets in production — they care about per-call cost variance, cache hit economics, queueing under burst, and the Goodhart drift of any cost metric, measure cost p50/p95 per outcome and routing override rate, and flag when tokens-per-landable-change is presented as a north star without a normalization story across change sizes.
review_areas: Whether cost-per-landable-change normalizes for change complexity, or whether trivial changes inflate the denominator
Whether the ~589-agent fleet has a utilization tail problem — long tail of agents that fire rarely but cost prompt engineering to maintain
Whether Opus-95-percent-of-cost (Feb 2026 baseline) is structural or incidental, and what the routing roadmap implies for that ratio
Whether evidence quarantine (48h delay) creates a windowed feedback loop that misses fast-moving model regressions
Whether multi-track / reaction-round expansion of review scope has a built-in efficiency check
How the metric behaves on epic-length campaigns vs single-PR sprints — same denominator unit

severity_examples.condition: A flurry of one-line changes inflates efficiency while real work degrades
severity_examples.scenario: Cost metric not normalized for change size

severity_examples.condition: Long tail of stub-tier agents drains design time and dilutes review signal
48h is too slow for fast model regressions and too fast for slow drifts

success_hints: Look for explicit normalization in the metric definition
Check whether the 64-plugin / 589-agent count is celebrated or scrutinized
See if there is a sunset path for unused capabilities
Note whether cost-per-landable-change has a confidence interval or just a point value
task_context: Reviewing the Sylveste v5.0 vision document to evaluate the cost-and-routing thesis. Goal: identify Goodhart and bloat risks under the north star metric.
